title: LLM-Rosetta Provider Shim
description: Schema for provider.yaml shim configuration files.

model_type.description: Capability category this shim serves. Required whenever 'format' is declared: a format name is scoped by this category, so the same spelling may name a chat format and an embedding format. Only a shim that declares 'base' and no 'format' may omit it; the base name then identifies the category (or it defaults to 'llm'). 'embedding' is the deprecated spelling of 'embeddings' and 'decision' of 'decisions'; the loader rewrites either with a warning.

format.description: Wire format within model_type. Validated against the converter registry for that category (see the (model_type, format) pair).

base.description: Deprecated alias for 'format'. When it names a model type (the old decision shims declared base: decision), model_type is taken from it and a format is still required.

logo.description: URL to the provider's logo image (SVG preferred).

display_name.description: This shim's own human-readable label (e.g. 'cluster_a' on 'acme_cluster_a--chat_completions'). Shown as the shim's row inside its group, for a shim that also declares 'group' or 'group_label'. A shim declaring neither was written against the older schema, where 'display_name' titled the group instead; that reading is kept, so its row label still comes from the name. Falls back to the segment after '--' in the name.

group.description: Top-level group this shim appears under in the admin provider-type picker. Falls back to the segment before '--' in the name, so a shim usually needs no declaration; declare it when one vendor spans several name prefixes (e.g. 'acme_cluster_a' and 'acme_cluster_b' both declaring 'acme'). The group's title — which is also the brand on free-source affordances — falls back to the capitalized group key, so a vendor that wants more than that declares 'group_label'.

group_label.description: Title of the shim's top-level group. Falls back to the group key. Keep it identical across the members of one group; as with 'logo', the last shim loaded wins.

free_source.description: Mark this provider as a source with a free model pool. The admin UI groups its keyless entry under a 'Free Resource' section.

response_id_prefix.description: Provider-specific prefix for response IDs (e.g. 'chatcmpl-', 'msg_', 'resp_'). Empty string means passthrough.

preserve_fields.description: Extra response/echo fields this provider adds to the base format's preserve set (e.g. the OpenAI-only lifecycle fields). Additive; the base format's spec-level set always applies.

soft_error_patterns.description: A 200 response whose body matches 'pattern' is treated as this status code and message.

store_default.description: Value for the 'store' field injected into a response resource when the upstream echo omits it. Omit to keep the base format's spec behavior (no forced store); true selects OpenAI's server-side-storage default.

hoist_system_messages.description: Whether to hoist late system messages for prompt cache prefix stability.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name for the API key (e.g. 'OPENAI_API_KEY').

models_path.description: Path or full URL for the upstream model list endpoint. Relative paths are appended to base_url.

default_path.description: Upstream endpoint path this shim serves for its model_type (e.g. '/v1/embeddings'). Used when a non-LLM endpoint names this shim but declares no explicit *_path.

model_id_field.description: JSON field name to use as model identifier when fetching the upstream model list. Defaults to 'id'.

auth_header.description: Custom auth header name (e.g. 'x-access-tokens'). When set, the API key is sent as this header instead of the base-type default (Bearer, x-api-key, x-goog-api-key).

keyless.description: The upstream accepts requests with no credential. No auth header is sent while no API key is configured; supplying one falls back to the base-type auth.

session_header.description: Name of a per-conversation session header the gateway injects on every inference request (e.g. 'x-opencode-session'). The value is derived per conversation; a client-supplied value is passed through verbatim.

headers.description: Static headers this upstream requires on every request (a client fingerprint: User-Agent, client marker). They are sent on inference, model listing and quota probes, and win over a client-forwarded header of the same name.

request_header.description: Name of a per-request identifier header the upstream validates (e.g. 'x-opencode-request'). A fresh value is minted for every upstream request.

session_id_format.description: Encoding for the session header's value. Omit for the gateway's plain sha256 digest; 'opencode' mints the vendor's timestamp-bearing identifier.

request_id_format.description: Encoding for the per-request identifier header's value.

stream_required.description: The upstream refuses non-streaming inference (stream: false). The gateway forces streaming upstream and reassembles the reply for a non-streaming client.

quota.description: Where this lane's allowance can be read. The probe parsers live in the gateway; the shim only names one.

url.description: Explicit usage URL when it is not derivable from base_url.

interval.description: Background probe interval in seconds. 0 reads on demand only.

demote_at.description: Used share at which a window demotes the credential. 100 keeps the vendor's own rule.

custom_tools.description: Whether the provider natively accepts custom tool definitions ({type: 'custom'}). When false, custom tools are downgraded to function wrappers.

max_description_length.description: Maximum length for tool description strings. Longer descriptions are truncated.

search_mode.description: 'disabled' drops tool_search items. 'native' passes through. 'bridge' emulates via BM25 search.

multimodal_result.description: Whether the provider supports multimodal content in tool results natively. null defers to the converter default.

intrinsic_tools.description: Provider-hosted server tools this provider supports natively (e.g. web_search, code_execution, google_search). Empty means no intrinsic tool support — the provider must opt in. Declaring a kind lets clients request it and lets cross-format conversion map it to this provider's native server tool.

tool_groups.description: Whether the provider carries a named group of client-declared tools ({'type': 'namespace', ...} on the Responses family). False means the converter folds group names into the flat tool names instead.

thinking_modes.description: Maps IR mode (auto/enabled/disabled) to provider thinking type value.

thinking_default.description: Default IR mode when the request has no explicit mode.

effort_field.description: Provider-side field path for the effort value (e.g. 'reasoning_effort', 'output_config.effort'). 'none' means provider does not accept effort.

effort_range.description: Supported IR effort range [floor, ceiling]. Values: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

budget_ratio.description: Derive budget_tokens as max(1024, int(max_tokens * ratio)).

visibility_modes.description: Maps IR summary value to provider visibility value.

unsigned_blocks.description: How to handle unsigned reasoning blocks in responses.

model_overrides.description: Per-model reasoning overrides keyed by upstream model ID. Each entry inherits from the provider-level reasoning config.

embeddings.description: Default request parameters for an embeddings shim, keyed by IR field name. A default fills only a field the client omitted. Only fields measured against the live endpoint belong here.

task_type.description: IR task type (e.g. retrieval_document); the converter maps it to the vendor's word.

encoding_format.description: IR encoding format (e.g. float, base64, int8).

truncation.description: Whether an over-long input is truncated.

rerank.description: Default request parameters for a rerank shim, keyed by IR field name. A default fills only a field the client omitted. Only fields measured against the live endpoint belong here.

return_documents.description: Whether the response carries the document text.

truncation.description: Whether an over-long document is truncated.

decision.description: Default request parameters for a decision shim. No parameter beyond the connection is measured for the decision formats today.
